navigation_routes.rule: Overview; derived accepted-package counts and current curriculum label.
10 canonical modules with lesson/category/search filtering; four appendices and reference groups accessible separately.
Render complete approved content by stable ID; previous/next uses the canonical 60-node order, not title or old chapter index. References return to their validated origin.
Keep 1–70 question validation and feedback modes. Derive availability from accepted active questions and distinct concepts; preflight all supported allocations.
Pinned question/options/key/content snapshot. Never replace the bank mid-session. Related lesson link remains unavailable before reveal in an active quiz.
Use the completed pinned session and its own score; if absent, show no saved result with an explicit setup action.
Review snapshot answers and use question ID → 7C lesson/source links. Preserve return context when entering a lesson.
Search canonical verified sign entries by code/title. Exact legacy-code lookup uses sign_routes; 3 missing exact entries remain explicit.

source_routes.general_alias_policy: Retain source ID and module scope. If a future alias has different scoped URLs and no scope is supplied, offer the applicable sources rather than choosing the first.
source_routes.legacy_external_link_policy: Previously recorded official URLs remain external references; they are not new canonical content destinations. Missing exact sign entries keep their recorded official URL as a separate, labelled action. No current external-link refetch is claimed.

state_rules.migration_rule: Map all eight states through navigation_routes; require valid content/session context. Missing session never recreates old results.
Preserve valid setup preference in the same process; validate 1–70 as today. Fresh launch default remains 70; do not silently turn invalid input into a running test.
Preserve IMMEDIATE/AT_END preference; active QuizSession.feedback is pinned and does not change with setup edits.
No durable session exists. Pin the complete versioned snapshot until finish or deliberate quit; normal app restart loses transient state as today.
Resolve known legacy title/range within the frozen namespace to a canonical ID or topic chooser; never carry the old Chapter object into the new reader.
Retain the five enum values; null remains All. Unknown values reset to All with no inferred module conversion.
Preserve a transient query when staying in the library; re-run against canonical content/tags. Optional legacy-title lookup returns canonical choices only. Fresh launch empty.
Retain All/Incorrect/Correct for the same pinned session. New/missing session resets to All; filter snapshot correctness, not revised current keys.
Validate the pending destination; dismiss keeps the session, confirm discards it and navigates atomically. Reset pending target on content/session replacement.
Keep only for the same session, question revision and shuffle snapshot. Change identity to include session/revision. Never reinterpret the index against newly ordered options.
Retain only within the same session/revision; reset on new session/content revision.
Keep original prompt, options/order, correct key, explanations, question revisions and package identity as the session snapshot.
Pinned at session creation; independent of later global setup preference.
Evaluate only against that session’s exact shuffled question. No mapping from a stored index to current-bank index is valid without the original order.
Keep for same snapshot and bounds; never use as curriculum progress or question identity.
Keep with same session; do not infer finished from route or from importing content.
Derive from the pinned questions/index; if context is missing, route explicitly to setup rather than fabricating a question.
Compute only with pinned answers and keys; never rescore a historical snapshot using revised bank content.

No records to convert or create in this migration. If a future separately authorised store exists, exact canonical ID/block aliases may preserve a bookmark; removed block falls back to its known parent with notice, removed content stays unavailable/tombstoned.

No completion data to convert. Future records require content version plus lesson semantic revision; unchanged lessons may keep credit, changed/split/merged lessons need explicit compatibility review. Old chapter/page coverage never awards new lesson completion.

No history dataset to migrate. Future history needs question ID/revision, option identity/order and original score snapshot. Preserve old outcomes as historical; rewrite/replace does not automatically transfer current mastery.
No schema migration, new database or cloud sync is authorised by 7E. Unknown imported storage is unsupported until separately audited; do not invent progress or infer it from chapter/page references.

resolution_policy.question_context_precedence: A known question ID overrides an old page; an unknown question must not fall through to a guessed page mapping.
resolution_policy.unknown_canonical: Show unavailable target. Offer library/search and any validated replacement; never silently open the first chapter/module.
resolution_policy.missing_block: If canonical parent is valid, open that parent with notice that the precise passage moved; do not fabricate a block offset.
resolution_policy.multi_target_alias: Show related canonical choices in curriculum order with reorganisation notice; do not pick the first or mark every target completed.
resolution_policy.invalid_legacy_page: Unknown namespace, gaps, noninteger or out-of-range values are unsupported. Do not use nearest-page or range clamping.
resolution_policy.retired_content: Keep a tombstone if retirement is actually approved. One reviewed replacement may be offered with notice; multiple replacements require a chooser; no replacement stays unavailable. Never recycle IDs.
resolution_policy.retired_question: Historical results remain historical and retired questions are excluded from new selection. Current 7D removes zero, so production tombstones are empty.
resolution_policy.unaccepted_replacement_question: Keep its teaching/source links; exclude from new scored selection until 7D acceptance passes. Derive eligible counts and preflight category/concept quotas before publishing a package.
resolution_policy.native_and_web_entry: All audited hosts launch App() without external content parsers/URL schemes. New internal typed destinations are planned; adding public deep links is separate work, not implied by aliases.

version_transition.initial_update: Existing app bundles content at compile time; normal restart clears remember/QuizSession state. No durable records are lost or converted by this migration because none exist in audited source.
version_transition.same_process_policy: If content replacement is later supported, switch packages atomically at a safe idle boundary. Pin an active/completed session’s full original snapshot until finish/quit/review; do not hot-swap its bank or implicitly discard unfinished answers.
version_transition.package_identity: Immutable app-content version binds curriculum release, accepted question revisions, assets, aliases and sources through a manifest digest. The unchanged approved PDF hash alone does not identify a revised app question bank.
version_transition.cross_version_reading: Keep original feedback/score in historical review. If opening newer teaching, state that learning material changed since the attempt; do not present an old result as a current assessment.
new_package_manifest: stable authored option_id per question revision

question_history_compatibility.retain: Same assessed semantic revision may preserve future mastery; metadata-only source/route edits do not regrade old attempts.
question_history_compatibility.rewrite: Default to a new revision and fresh current assessment; keep any prior result as a versioned historical attempt. No automatic index-based transfer, including editorial-only edits without an explicit compatibility decision.
question_history_compatibility.replace: New revision; keep same ID only for the same reviewed sign/objective, and never score the old asset snapshot as the new question.
question_history_compatibility.remove: No baseline removal. Future retirement excludes new selection but keeps valid historical snapshots without claiming current mastery.

version_transition.unversioned_or_orderless_answers: Do not regrade or reinterpret. Mark unsupported legacy evidence if a separately audited import ever provides it; never assume selected index 0 was the correct canonical option.
version_transition.future_bookmark_completion_scope: Conditional compatibility rules above do not create a bookmark/completion/history store or authorise new persistence.
